rook.description: A male American English voice, in his early forties, low baritone with a slightly gravelly texture. A seasoned military squad leader. Natural cinematic acting, authoritative but human. Close microphone, clean studio recording, no music or sound effects.

atlas.description: A male American English voice, in his mid twenties, a brighter mid pitched tenor with a clear youthful timbre. A quick thinking technical specialist, conversational and a little nervous. Natural cinematic acting, never cartoonish. Close microphone, clean studio recording, no music or sound effects.

control.description: A female American English voice, in her late thirties, warm lower mid pitch, clear precise diction. An experienced military radio operator, composed and assured, with understated concern. Natural cinematic acting. Close microphone, clean studio recording, no radio effects, music or sound effects.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Blackout Station. No lights, no traffic. Atlas, stay close. Control, we're at the west gate.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Copy. Emergency power should still be online. Get inside and find out what shut it down.
lines.direction: Measured, professional instructions, with a slight note of concern.

lines.speaker: atlas
lines.text: That wasn't a shutdown. Someone cut the feed... Rook, those doors are moving.
lines.direction: Starts analytical; becomes alarmed at the final sentence.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: Contact! Behind the glass! Get down!
lines.direction: One brief burst of urgent shouting, intelligible and forceful.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Rook, report. I've lost your camera.
lines.direction: Controlled urgency. The situation is deteriorating.

lines.speaker: atlas
lines.text: We're here. They're waiting for us. Give me ten seconds with that relay.
lines.direction: Recovering from a shock, then speaking quickly and decisively.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: You've got five. I'll cover the hall. Keep your head down.
lines.direction: Firm, urgent, protective; back to a normal speaking volume.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Listen carefully. Restore power, recover the records, then head for the seawall. No detours.
lines.direction: Precise and focused, increasing urgency without shouting.

lines.speaker: atlas
lines.text: Right. Lights first. Bad decisions after.
lines.direction: Dry nervous humor under the breath, restrained and believable.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: On me. We finish this together.
lines.direction: Steady resolve, a quiet rallying instruction.
